bullets: Learn one cloud platform - AWS, Azure or GCP
Get hands-on with a SIEM like Splunk or Sentinel
Add basic scripting - Python or Bash is enough
Document everything on GitHub or a blog

caption: Cloud skills show up in almost every senior cyber job spec - and they close the biggest pay gaps. Start with one platform and go deep. #cybersecurity #cloudsecurity #cybersecuritycareers #cypherjobs #techjobs
